lines.text: Once there was a boy who he liked reading books
lines.reason: 关系代词who已经作liked的主语，再加he形成重复主语。

lines.text: very much. Because he was so poor to buy any books, he
lines.reason: too … to … 表太穷而买不起书；so后若表达结果需接that从句。

lines.text: had no books of him own. But that could not stop him from
lines.reason: of his own表示他自己的，own前须形容词性物主代词his。

lines.text: reading. He decided borrow books from his friend Tom,
lines.reason: decide to do表示决定做，borrow前需to。

lines.text: who lived far away to the boy's home. The boy always
lines.reason: far away from表示远离，地点距离用from而非to。

lines.text: tried his best to finish read the books and then returned
lines.reason: finish后接动名词，完成阅读用finish reading。

lines.text: them to his friends in time. That was the reason why
lines.reason: 前面明确只向朋友Tom借书，归还对象是同一个单数friend。

lines.text: Tom was glad to lend him any of his books.
lines.reason: be glad to do和lend sb sth均正确，any of his books表示自己的任何一本书。

lines.text: The many books the boy read, the more knowledge he
lines.reason: the + 比较级，the + 比较级表越……越……，many需用more。

lines.text: learned. And late he became a great writer.
lines.reason: 叙述后来成为作家用later；late表示迟到或时间晚，不表示后来的先后关系。
